models.name: erp_hrm_guests
models.description:
Temporary guest accounts identified by device for anonymous access before registration or login.

This table stores guest user sessions identified by device identifier. Guest accounts are lightweight, anonymous identities that allow users to browse or perform limited actions before registering or logging in. Guest accounts may be converted to full member accounts or discarded. The soft delete pattern with deleted_at allows cleanup of stale guest records.

plainFields.name: device_identifier
plainFields.description: Unique device identifier used for anonymous guest identification and session binding.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was soft deleted. Null if active.

models.name: erp_hrm_guest_sessions
models.description: Temporary session tokens for guest access with expiration. Stores connection metadata (IP address, requested URL, referrer) for audit trail and session management. Each session belongs to one guest and automatically expires based on the configured session duration.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_guest_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged guest's {@link erp_hrm_guests.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address from the request for security audit and geographic tracking.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Requested URL path for session activity tracking.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer header indicating the previous page URL.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp when the session becomes invalid.

models.name: erp_hrm_members
models.description: Registered user accounts with email and password credentials for authentication. Users can belong to multiple organizations via Employee records (erp_hrm_employees), with a shared global profile across all organizations they belong to. This is the canonical identity record for authenticated member actors in the system.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address used for login and account identification.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Bcrypt hashed password for secure authentication.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: User's display name shown across all organizations.

plainFields.name: avatar_uri
plainFields.description: URI to user's avatar image file.

plainFields.name: phone
plainFields.description: User's phone number for contact purposes.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for soft deletion. Null if account is active.

models.name: erp_hrm_member_sessions
models.description: JWT session tokens for member authentication with access and refresh token support. Tracks member login sessions including client metadata, token validity, and session lifecycle. Each session belongs to one member via erp_hrm_member_id. Sessions are created on login and invalidated on logout or expiration.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_member_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged member's {@link erp_hrm_members.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address from the login request.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Current request URL when session was created.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer header from the login request.

plainFields.name: access_token
plainFields.description: JWT access token string for authenticated API requests.

plainFields.name: refresh_token
plainFields.description: JWT refresh token string for obtaining new access tokens.

plainFields.name: token_expired_at
plainFields.description: Expiration timestamp of the access token.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp.

models.name: erp_hrm_member_password_resets
models.description: Password reset tokens for member accounts with expiration and usage tracking. Each token is linked to a specific member and can only be used once to reset their password. Supports soft deletion for audit trail compliance.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_member_id
foreignFields.description: Member who requested the password reset. {@link erp_hrm_members.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Hashed reset token string for security. Tokens should be hashed before storage.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiration timestamp after which the token becomes invalid.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the token was successfully used to reset password. Null if unused.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset was requested.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last update to this record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for audit trail. Null if not deleted.

models.name: erp_hrm_member_email_verifications
models.description: Email verification tokens for member registration email verification. Stores temporary tokens sent to new members during registration to confirm email ownership. Tokens have expiration timestamps and are marked as verified once the member completes the verification process.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_member_id
foreignFields.description: Member whose email is being verified. {@link erp_hrm_members.id}

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique verification token string sent to the member's email for verification.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this verification token expires and becomes invalid.

plainFields.name: verified_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this verification token was successfully verified by the member. Null if not yet verified.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this verification record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this verification record was last updated.

models.name: erp_hrm_admins
models.description: Administrator accounts with elevated privileges for organization management. Admin users have full access to organization settings, employee management, project oversight, and time tracking approvals. Each admin has their own authentication credentials separate from regular member accounts.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Email address used for authentication. Must be unique across all admin accounts.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Bcrypt hashed password for secure authentication.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Admin's display name shown in the interface and activity logs.

plainFields.name: avatar_uri
plainFields.description: URL to the admin's profile avatar image.

plainFields.name: phone
plainFields.description: Contact phone number for the admin.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin account was last updated.

models.name: erp_hrm_admin_sessions
models.description: JWT session tokens for administrator authentication with access and refresh token support. Each session records the admin's login context including IP address, navigation history, and expiration time. Sessions are created upon admin login and invalidated upon logout or expiration.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged administrator's {@link erp_hrm_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address from which the session was created.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Current request URL path for session tracking.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer header indicating the previous page URL.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires and becomes invalid.

models.name: erp_hrm_admin_password_resets
models.description: Password reset tokens for administrator password recovery. Stores hashed reset tokens with expiration timestamps, supporting single-use token semantics. Each admin can have only one active password reset request at a time.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_admin_id
foreignFields.description: The administrator requesting password reset. {@link erp_hrm_admins.id}

plainFields.name: token_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password reset token for security.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiration timestamp of the reset token. After this time, the token is invalid.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the token was used to reset the password. Null if not yet used.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset request was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the record was last updated.

models.name: erp_hrm_admin_audit_logs
models.description: Immutable audit trail recording administrative actions performed by administrators within the system for security compliance and accountability purposes. Each record captures the admin who performed the action, the action type, the target entity that was affected, and additional metadata in JSON format. Action types include: employee invited/deactivated/reactived, contract created/edited, project created/archived/completed/deleted, task status changed, timesheet submitted/approved/rejected, and role assigned/changed.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the administrator who performed this action. {@link erp_hrm_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: action_type
plainFields.description: Type of administrative action performed (e.g., employee_invited, employee_deactivated, contract_created, project_archived, timesheet_approved).

plainFields.name: target_entity
plainFields.description: Type of entity that was affected by this action (e.g., employee, contract, project, task, timesheet, role).

plainFields.name: target_id
plainFields.description: UUID of the entity that was affected by this action.

plainFields.name: metadata
plainFields.description: JSON-formatted additional context about the action such as old/new values, reason for rejection, or other relevant details.

plainFields.name: ip_address
plainFields.description: IP address from which the admin performed this action for security auditing.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this action was performed. Audit records are immutable.

models.name: erp_hrm_organizations
models.description: Main tenant container entity representing an organization with its identity and configuration settings. This is the fundamental isolation boundary in the multi-tenant erp_hrm system. All employees, projects, departments, roles, and time tracking data belong to an organization. Each organization has one owner (a member) who has full administrative control including editing settings and deleting the organization.

foreignFields.name: owner_id
foreignFields.description: Organization owner who has full administrative control. {@link erp_hrm_members.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Organization display name shown throughout the application.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional description of the organization.

plainFields.name: logo_uri
plainFields.description: URL to the organization's logo image.

plainFields.name: currency
plainFields.description: Organization's primary currency code for billing and reports (e.g., USD, EUR, KRW).

plainFields.name: timezone
plainFields.description: Organization's timezone for time tracking and scheduling (e.g., Asia/Seoul, America/New_York).

plainFields.name: fiscal_start_month
plainFields.description: Month (1-12) when the organization's fiscal year starts.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the organization was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the organization was last modified.

models.name: erp_hrm_activity_logs
models.description: Organization-level activity audit trail recording significant actions performed by users within the organization. Each log entry creates a permanent record of what happened, who performed it, when it occurred, and what was affected. Activity logs support historical review of organizational changes and help administrators trace entity history back to source actions. Logs are append-only; once recorded, an activity log entry cannot be modified or deleted. All logs are strictly scoped to their organization ensuring complete data isolation between tenants. Logged actions include employee management events (invited, deactivated, reactivated), contract lifecycle (created, edited), project lifecycle (created, archived, completed, deleted), task status changes, timesheet workflow (submitted, approved, rejected), and role assignments.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_organization_id
foreignFields.description: Organization to which this activity log belongs. {@link erp_hrm_organizations.id}.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_member_id
foreignFields.description: Member who performed this action. {@link erp_hrm_members.id}.

plainFields.name: action_type
plainFields.description: Category of the action performed. Values: employee_invited, employee_deactivated, employee_reactivated, contract_created, contract_edited, project_created, project_archived, project_completed, project_deleted, task_status_changed, timesheet_submitted, timesheet_approved, timesheet_rejected, role_assigned, role_changed.

plainFields.name: target_entity_type
plainFields.description: Type of the entity that was affected by this action. Examples: employee, contract, project, task, timesheet, role.

plainFields.name: target_entity_id
plainFields.description: UUID of the entity that was affected by this action.

plainFields.name: details
plainFields.description: Additional context about the action in JSON format. Contains specific change information such as old/new values, affected fields, or supplementary notes.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the action occurred.

models.name: erp_hrm_reports
models.description:
Stored reports generated for the organization including time reports, project budget reports, and weekly summary reports with their filter criteria and metadata.

Each report is scoped to a single organization and contains the parameters used to generate it (date range, filtering criteria, grouping preferences). Reports are generated on-demand by authorized users and stored for later reference. The report_type field determines the type of analysis: time reports show hours logged with billable breakdown, project budget reports compare estimated vs actual hours, and weekly summary reports provide rolling week-by-week metrics.

This table references {@link erp_hrm_organizations} for the tenant context and {@link erp_hrm_members} for the user who generated the report.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_organization_id
foreignFields.description: The organization this report belongs to. {@link erp_hrm_organizations.id}.

foreignFields.name: generated_by_erp_hrm_member_id
foreignFields.description: The member who generated this report. {@link erp_hrm_members.id}.

plainFields.name: report_type
plainFields.description: Type of report determining the analysis format. Values: time_report, project_budget_report, weekly_summary_report.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Optional display name for the report.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the report was generated.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the report was last updated.

models.name: erp_hrm_report_parameters
models.description: Normalized filter parameters for reports, replacing JSON parameters field with proper columns for date range, employee/project/task filters, grouping preferences, and billable status. Each report has exactly one set of parameters in a 1:1 relationship with erp_hrm_reports.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_report_id
foreignFields.description: Associated report's {@link erp_hrm_reports.id}. Each report has exactly one set of parameters in a 1:1 relationship.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: Start date of the report date range filter.

plainFields.name: end_date
plainFields.description: End date of the report date range filter.

plainFields.name: employee_id
plainFields.description: Optional filter for specific employee. When null, report includes all employees.

plainFields.name: project_id
plainFields.description: Optional filter for specific project. When null, report includes all projects.

plainFields.name: task_id
plainFields.description: Optional filter for specific task. When null, report includes all tasks.

plainFields.name: billable
plainFields.description: Filter for billable status. True = billable only, False = non-billable only, Null = include all.

plainFields.name: group_by
plainFields.description: Grouping preference for the report: 'employee', 'project', or 'task'.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the parameters were created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the parameters were last updated.

models.name: erp_hrm_employees
models.description:
Employee records linking users to organizations with role assignments and employment details.

Each employee record represents the association between a user account (member) and an organization. Employees are assigned a role that determines their permissions within the organization. Each employee can optionally belong to a department and can have multiple employment contracts (though only one can be active at a time).

An employee must have an active status to log time or submit timesheets. Deactivated employees preserve their historical data but cannot perform time tracking operations.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_member_id
foreignFields.description: User account associated with this employee record. {@link erp_hrm_members.id}.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_organization_id
foreignFields.description: Organization this employee belongs to. {@link erp_hrm_organizations.id}.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_role_id
foreignFields.description: Role assigned to this employee determining their permissions. {@link erp_hrm_roles.id}.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_department_id
foreignFields.description: Optional department this employee belongs to. {@link erp_hrm_departments.id}.

plainFields.name: position
plainFields.description: Job title or position of the employee within the organization.

plainFields.name: employment_type
plainFields.description: Type of employment classification. Valid values: full-time, part-time, contractor, intern.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Employment status. Valid values: active (can log time and submit timesheets), deactivated (historical data preserved but cannot perform time tracking).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the employee record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the employee record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the employee record was soft deleted. Null if not deleted.

models.name: erp_hrm_roles
models.description: Organization-scoped roles defining permission sets for employees. Each role contains a name and a collection of permissions that determine what actions assigned employees can perform. Three built-in roles (Owner, Manager, Employee) cannot be deleted, while custom roles can be created and managed by organization owners with org:manage permission. All role names must be unique within an organization scope. Links to employees via {@link erp_hrm_employees.role_id} and to permissions via {@link erp_hrm_role_permissions}.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_organization_id
foreignFields.description: Organization this role belongs to. {@link erp_hrm_organizations.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Role name unique within the organization. Examples: Owner, Manager, Employee, or custom role names.

plainFields.name: is_builtin
plainFields.description: Whether this is a built-in role that cannot be deleted. Built-in roles are Owner, Manager, and Employee.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the role was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the role was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Null if not deleted.

models.name: erp_hrm_role_permissions
models.description: Junction table linking roles to their assigned permissions. Each role can have multiple permissions, and each permission can be assigned to multiple roles. Permissions are string codes (e.g., 'org:manage', 'employee:manage', 'project:view'). This table enforces that the same permission cannot be assigned twice to the same role.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_role_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged role's {@link erp_hrm_roles.id}.

plainFields.name: permission
plainFields.description: Permission code string such as 'org:manage', 'employee:manage', 'employee:view', 'project:manage', 'project:view', 'time:manage', 'time:approve', 'time:view_all', or 'report:view'.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

models.name: erp_hrm_departments
models.description:
Organization departments supporting optional one-level parent hierarchy for organizational structure.

Each department belongs to exactly one organization and can optionally have a parent department for hierarchical categorization. The one-level parent constraint ensures simple organizational structures without deep nesting. Departments provide a way to group employees within an organization for reporting and management purposes.

Related entities:
- Belongs to {@link erp_hrm_organizations} as the tenant container
- Employees in {@link erp_hrm_employees} reference this for department assignment
- Parent department creates self-referential hierarchy via {@link erp_hrm_departments.parent_id}

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_organization_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged organization's {@link erp_hrm_organizations.id}. Each department must belong to an organization for multi-tenant isolation.

foreignFields.name: parent_id
foreignFields.description: Optional parent department's {@link erp_hrm_departments.id} for one-level hierarchical categorization. Null indicates a root-level department.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Department name used for identification within the organization.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional description providing details about the department's purpose or responsibilities.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the department was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the department was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Null means active, non-null means deleted.

models.name: erp_hrm_contracts
models.description:
Employee contracts storing employment terms with temporal constraints. Each contract defines pay rate, pay period, working hours, and validity dates for an employment relationship. Only one contract can be active at a time per employee. Contracts are immutable historical records - past contracts cannot be edited once superseded.

This table is always managed through its parent {@link erp_hrm_employees} entity. Users cannot create, search, or manage contracts independently from employees.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_employee_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged employee this contract belongs to. {@link erp_hrm_employees.id}

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: Contract start date. Required. Marks when this contract term begins.

plainFields.name: end_date
plainFields.description: Contract end date. Optional - null indicates an ongoing contract with no end date.

plainFields.name: pay_rate
plainFields.description: Pay rate amount for this contract. Numeric value representing compensation.

plainFields.name: pay_period
plainFields.description: Pay period type. One of: hourly, daily, weekly, monthly. Determines how pay rate is applied.

plainFields.name: working_hours_per_week
plainFields.description: Contracted working hours per week. Required numeric value.

plainFields.name: notes
plainFields.description: Optional notes or comments about this contract.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this contract was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this contract was last updated.

models.name: erp_hrm_projects
models.description:
Work containers that organize time tracking and task management within an organization.

Each project serves as a central hub for grouping related work items and time entries. Projects support lifecycle management through status transitions (active, archived, completed) and can optionally include budget tracking and date boundaries. All project data is strictly isolated within the owning organization.

Projects have relationships with project members (employee assignments with roles), tasks (work items that can be assigned to members), and timelogs (time entries logged against the project). The color code enables visual differentiation in UI displays.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_organization_id
foreignFields.description: Organization that owns this project. {@link erp_hrm_organizations.id}

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Project name displayed in the UI and used for identification.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional detailed description explaining the project's purpose and scope.

plainFields.name: color
plainFields.description: Hex color code for UI visual differentiation (e.g., #FF5733).

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Project lifecycle status. Values: active (receiving timelogs), archived (no new timelogs), completed (no new timelogs).

plainFields.name: budget_hours
plainFields.description: Total estimated hours for the project. Used for budget tracking reports.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: Optional planned start date for the project.

plainFields.name: end_date
plainFields.description: Optional planned end date for the project.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the project was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the project was last modified.

models.name: erp_hrm_project_members
models.description: Links employees to projects with assigned roles, enabling employee participation in multiple projects. Each record represents an employee's membership in a project with a specific role (member or project-lead) that determines their permissions within that project.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_employee_id
foreignFields.description: Linked employee who is assigned to the project. {@link erp_hrm_employees.id}.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_project_id
foreignFields.description: Linked project that the employee is assigned to. {@link erp_hrm_projects.id}.

plainFields.name: assigned_role
plainFields.description: Role assigned to the employee in this project. Values: 'member' (regular project member) or 'project_lead' (manages tasks in the project).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the employee was assigned to the project.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the project membership was last updated.

models.name: erp_hrm_tasks
models.description: Work items within a project for task assignment and tracking. Tasks support one level of subtasking via optional parent task reference. Each task has status (open, in-progress, completed, closed) and priority (low, medium, high, urgent) for workflow management. Task status changes are recorded in {@link erp_hrm_task_histories} for audit trail.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_project_id
foreignFields.description: Project this task belongs to. {@link erp_hrm_projects.id}.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_employee_id
foreignFields.description: Employee assigned to this task. {@link erp_hrm_employees.id}. Optional - must be a project member.

foreignFields.name: parent_id
foreignFields.description: Parent task for subtasking. {@link erp_hrm_tasks.id}. Optional - one level of nesting only.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Task title describing the work to be done.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the task.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Task workflow status. Values: open, in-progress, completed, closed.

plainFields.name: priority
plainFields.description: Task priority level. Values: low, medium, high, urgent.

plainFields.name: estimated_hours
plainFields.description: Estimated hours to complete the task.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Task due date for deadline tracking.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the task was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the task was last modified.

models.name: erp_hrm_task_histories
models.description: Immutable audit trail that records each status transition made to a task throughout its lifecycle. Every time a task changes from one status to another, a new history entry is automatically created to document that change. The history serves as an immutable record that tracks the complete progression of a task from its initial status through all subsequent changes until completion. This record cannot be modified, deleted, or reordered once created. Users can review this history to understand the progression of work on a task, identify when specific status transitions occurred, and determine who was responsible for each change. {@link erp_hrm_tasks} owns this audit trail through the task_id foreign key.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_task_id
foreignFields.description: The task whose status was changed. {@link erp_hrm_tasks.id}

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_member_id
foreignFields.description: The member who initiated the status change. {@link erp_hrm_members.id}

plainFields.name: previous_status
plainFields.description: The status value the task held before the change was initiated.

plainFields.name: new_status
plainFields.description: The status value the task now holds after the change was completed.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the status change occurred.

models.name: erp_hrm_timelogs
models.description: Individual time entries logged by employees with date, duration, project/task associations, and billable flag. Each timelog records a discrete time tracking entry that employees can create, edit, and delete subject to timesheet workflow constraints. Timelogs not yet included in submitted/approved timesheets can be freely modified, while those in approved timesheets are locked from editing.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_employee_id
foreignFields.description: Employee who logged this time entry. {@link erp_hrm_employees.id}

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_project_id
foreignFields.description: Project to which this time entry is associated. {@link erp_hrm_projects.id}

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_task_id
foreignFields.description: Optional task within the project that this time entry is logged against. {@link erp_hrm_tasks.id}

plainFields.name: date
plainFields.description: Date when the time was logged (date portion only, time portion ignored).

plainFields.name: duration_minutes
plainFields.description: Duration of the time entry in minutes.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional description explaining what work was done during this time entry.

plainFields.name: billable
plainFields.description: Flag indicating whether this time entry is billable to the client. Default is true.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this timelog record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this timelog record was last updated.

models.name: erp_hrm_timesheets
models.description:
Weekly timesheet container grouping timelogs for submission and approval workflow with status tracking.

Each timesheet represents a work week (Monday to Sunday) belonging to an employee. The employee creates a draft timesheet, adds/removes timelogs, and submits for approval. Users with time:approve permission can approve or reject submitted timesheets. Approved timesheets lock all included timelogs. Rejected timesheets return to draft status for resubmission.

Workflow status transitions: draft → submitted → approved | rejected (back to draft). The total_hours field is calculated from included timelogs for reporting efficiency. The reviewer_employee field is populated when a timesheet is approved or rejected.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_employee_id
foreignFields.description: Employee who owns this timesheet and whose timelogs are aggregated. {@link erp_hrm_employees.id}.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_reviewer_employee_id
foreignFields.description: Employee who reviewed (approved or rejected) this timesheet. {@link erp_hrm_employees.id}. Null until timesheet is approved or rejected.

plainFields.name: week_start_date
plainFields.description: Start date of the timesheet week, always a Monday. Used with week_end_date to define the billing period.

plainFields.name: week_end_date
plainFields.description: End date of the timesheet week, always a Sunday. Used with week_start_date to define the billing period.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current workflow status of the timesheet. Values: draft (editable, not submitted), submitted (awaiting approval), approved (locked), rejected (returned to draft with reason).

plainFields.name: total_hours
plainFields.description: Total hours calculated from all timelogs included in this timesheet. Used for quick reporting without recalculating.

plainFields.name: submitted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the employee submitted this timesheet for approval. Null until submitted.

plainFields.name: reviewed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when a reviewer approved or rejected this timesheet. Null until reviewed.

plainFields.name: rejection_reason
plainFields.description: Reason provided when rejecting a submitted timesheet. Required when status changes to rejected.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this timesheet was created as a draft.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this timesheet was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for soft deletion. Null when active, set when deleted.

models.name: erp_hrm_timers
models.description:
Live timer sessions for real-time time tracking that convert to timelogs when stopped.

Each timer is owned by an employee and tracks time against a specific project. The timer records when it was started, which project and optional task are being timed, and an optional description of the work.

Business rules:
- Each employee can have at most one active timer at a time (enforced by unique employee_id)
- Stopping a timer creates a corresponding timelog entry
- Discarding a timer removes it without creating any timelog
- Timers can be edited while running (description, project, task)

Referenced by erp_hrm_employees for timer ownership and erp_hrm_timelogs for the conversion relationship.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_employee_id
foreignFields.description: Employee who owns and controls this timer. {@link erp_hrm_employees.id}

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_project_id
foreignFields.description: Project being timed. {@link erp_hrm_projects.id}

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_task_id
foreignFields.description: Task being timed, optional. {@link erp_hrm_tasks.id}

plainFields.name: started_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the timer was started.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional description of the work being timed.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

models.name: erp_hrm_timesheet_timelogs
models.description: Junction table linking timesheets to their contained timelogs, supporting the workflow of adding or removing entries from draft timesheets. Each record represents an association between a timesheet and a timelog, enabling employees to include or exclude specific time entries when preparing timesheets for submission.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_timesheet_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the timesheet this timelog is associated with. {@link erp_hrm_timesheets.id}

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_timelog_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the timelog being associated with the timesheet. {@link erp_hrm_timelogs.id}

plainFields.name: added_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the timelog was added to the timesheet.

models.name: erp_hrm_invitations
models.description: Email invitations sent to potential employees to join an organization as team members. Each invitation belongs to one organization and targets a specific email address. Invitations track their lifecycle from creation through acceptance or expiration. When inviting an existing user, the employee record is created immediately. When inviting a new user, a pending invitation is created and automatically linked when the user registers with that email. {@link erp_hrm_organizations} is the owning organization. Optional role and department assignments can be pre-specified for streamlined onboarding.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_organization_id
foreignFields.description: Organization that sent this invitation. {@link erp_hrm_organizations.id}

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_role_id
foreignFields.description: Pre-assigned role for the invited employee. Optional - can be changed after onboarding. {@link erp_hrm_roles.id}

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_department_id
foreignFields.description: Pre-assigned department for the invited employee. Optional. {@link erp_hrm_departments.id}

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Email address of the person being invited. Serves as the unique identifier for matching invitations to users during registration.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current state of the invitation. Values: pending (awaiting user registration), accepted (user joined organization), expired (no longer valid).

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Secure token for invitation link. Used to verify invitation authenticity when accessed.

plainFields.name: position
plainFields.description: Pre-specified position or job title for the invited employee.

plainFields.name: note
plainFields.description: Optional message from the organization to the invited person.

plainFields.name: accepted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the invitation was accepted and employee record was created.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this invitation expires and becomes invalid.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the invitation was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the invitation was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for soft deletion. Null if not deleted.
